note: Each track is a whole maqam, often 15 to 20 minutes, ending in a short pesteh song. Titles are transliterated from Arabic and spelled differently on almost every release.

size.basis: The repertoire is about 56 named maqam compositions (Rough Trade on Hamid Al-Saadi), each recorded many times since 78 rpm days by a few dozen named singers (Wikipedia lists 27), with Muhammad al-Qubanchi the most recorded artist of the early record era (Qatar Digital Library). Commercial albums outside Iraq are few ('one of a handful of commercially released albums in the genre', Rough Trade), but Iraqi radio and television archives and 78s add many more. A judgement, not a count: roughly 800–4000 recorded maqam performances, of which about 50 (the main maqams by Qubanchi, Yusuf Omar, Nazem al-Ghazali, al-A‘dhami, Farida, Hamid al-Saadi) would be called essential.
